intervals: 10000 patient bootstrap resamples of patient excesses; percentile95% intervals condition on observed patients/annotations/bins and estimated null means. They do not cover confounding or model misspecification.
interpretation_limits: Greater observed score variance indicates joint dependence beyond the coarse-conditioned independence reference; it does not establish coordinated regulation or a causal persister state.
Positive dependence can increase or decrease a thresholded breadth fraction, depending on marginals. A negative>=5 excess does not mean no coherence.
Covariance cannot shift the expected additive mean when gene marginals are preserved; never claim it explains mean-score reversal.
A small or null discrepancy does not exclude real programs under sparse measurement.
Preserve both endpoints, nulls and all patient directions; do not select a favorable patient or assay.
null_boundary: Permuted normalized vectors are not synthetic count vectors with valid conserved totalUMI; this is a conditional association diagnostic, not a multinomial molecular mechanism.
